---
title: "TAOOH second-order Markov model — fitting"
subtitle: "Full proportional-odds second-order models, one per imputation"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(mostr)
library(posterior)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "markov.R"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_main)

imputation_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "results", "imputations")
results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "03-second-order-markov", "results")
model_dir <- here(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# A small number of divergences is retained for review rather than causing an
# automatic full refit. Twenty or more divergences still trigger the retry.
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds <- config$diagnostics
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds$max_divergent_transitions <- 19L

treatment_prior <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.541
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-models
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- here(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  data <- read_parquet(
    here(imputation_dir, sprintf("completed-%02d.parquet", index))
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE))

  # mostr's default first follow-up time (week 1) must be in the model data.
  stopifnot(min(data$week) == 1L)

  dd <- datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev +
    week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev +
    ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis + rms::rcs(albumin, 3) +
    rms::rcs(c_reactive_protein, 3) + cluster(id)
  fit_seed <- config$seeds$taooh + (index - 1L) * 1000L

  fit <- tryCatch(
    blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = treatment_prior,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$warmup,
      refresh = 1,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    ),
    error = identity
  )

  diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    NULL
  } else {
    tryCatch(
      markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds),
      error = function(error) NULL
    )
  }

  if (is.null(diagnostics) || !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    fit <- blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = treatment_prior,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds)
  }

  if (!isTRUE(fit$pppo == 0L) || !is.null(fit$cppo)) {
    stop("The second-order TAOOH model must be a full proportional-odds model.")
  }
  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
